description: Catalogue a PE, ELF or Mach-O executable without running it: pe_info's structure (long tables kept whole in files) and a complete entropy profile, with a status taken from what the parsers say they read.
covers: Static headers, sections or segments, imports or linked libraries, and whole-file entropy, as far as the parsers' own status says (coverage.json: status, warnings, omissions, limits_hit, errors; a zero exit code is not completeness). It does not execute, unpack, decompile, verify a signature or claim observed behaviour.
